description: This file is a shell script used for performance testing of the core.fsmonitor feature in Git. It sets up various test environments, configures Git settings, and runs performance benchmarks related to file system monitoring mechanisms like Watchman and the built-in fsmonitor daemon. The script manages the environment, initializes repositories, and runs different Git commands to measure performance under various conditions.

methods.name: trace_start
methods.description: Initializes trace logging by creating a trace directory and setting environment variables for performance tracing.

methods.name: trace_stop
methods.description: Stops trace logging by unsetting tracing environment variables.

methods.name: touch_files
methods.description: Creates specified number of empty files within a numbered directory.

methods.name: setup_for_fsmonitor_hook
methods.description: Configures the environment for fsmonitor using hooks, selecting appropriate scripts based on prerequisites like Watchman.

methods.name: test_perf_w_drop_caches
methods.description: Runs performance tests with optional OS cache dropping based on environment variables.

methods.name: test_fsmonitor_suite
methods.description: Executes a comprehensive suite of performance tests related to the fsmonitor feature, including status checks, diffs, and adding files, under different configurations.
